GoalOptions.Label: Secure Investment
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to secure Board approval and investment for the full-scale deployment of the Predictive Resource Scaling & Optimization system. This document should clearly articulate the ROI and strategic imperative, demonstrating how this solution aligns with our financial and technological objectives.

GoalOptions.Label: Align Engineering
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to align the VP Engineering and their teams on the technical vision and implementation roadmap for the AI-driven resource scaling solution. It should foster understanding of the architectural principles and the critical role of each component in achieving our performance and cost targets.

GoalOptions.Label: Showcase Innovation
GoalOptions.Text: The objective is to showcase our leadership in Cloud Infrastructure AI, highlighting the innovative application of machine learning for dynamic resource management. This will position the company as a pioneer, attracting top talent and potential strategic partnerships in the AI/cloud domain.

GoalOptions.Label: Validate Performance
GoalOptions.Text: This document seeks to validate the initial performance and cost-saving capabilities of the Predictive Resource Scaling & Optimization system. It should present compelling evidence that the solution meets or exceeds the targeted 15-25% cloud spend reduction and real-time scaling requirements.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial Viability & Impact
Criteria: Board approval for full funding of the solution's next phase.
Demonstrated potential for 15-25% annual cloud spend reduction.
Clear articulation of competitive advantage gained through AI-driven optimization.
Positive feedback from Board members regarding strategic alignment and ROI.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Readiness & Scalability
Criteria: VP Engineering endorsement of the proposed architecture and implementation plan.
Confirmation that the system can achieve real-time scaling decisions within 5 minutes.
Evidence of prediction accuracy >90% for critical cloud resources.
Identification of clear next steps for integration into existing cloud infrastructure.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Efficiency & Risk Mitigation
Criteria: Confirmation that the solution enhances operational stability and reduces manual intervention.
Assessment of potential risks (e.g., model drift, data quality) and mitigation strategies.
Clarity on resource requirements (human and technical) for ongoing maintenance and evolution.
Agreement on key performance indicators (KPIs) for continuous monitoring post-deployment.
